verdict.rationale: MX's docs say users can download the OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman (mx-docs-12, mx-docs-26, mx-docs-31). An official GitHub repository (mxenabled/openapi) holds the OpenAPI spec for the MX Platform API (mx-gh-1). The probe's 404s on guessed paths like /openapi.json do not contradict this, since the spec is published through the docs link and GitHub repo, not at a conventional URL. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and current, and a spec served at a standard discoverable path such as /openapi.json.
